verdicts.decision_note: The observed false recording establishes the implementation-relevant data rule that failed mint attempts must not be registered or counted as successful mints.
First concrete failure: two unsuccessful ETH mint attempts were recorded as completed mints.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports changing database registration to exclude unsuccessful transactions.
Post-fix persistence: the authoritative mint count remained inflated despite the absence of corresponding paid mints.

First concrete verification for the successful USDC path: an executed mint transaction was counted and its pool contribution was recorded; the separate NFT-visibility failure does not negate this recording observation.
